segments.text: Uzbekistan da basan is min doldar maash alay digan tasp igalar haqda bular midingiz?
Ularga bolgan talab shu daraca yukhari ki, hatta dunyo boylab 5-5 milyonga yaqan ish orni makchub.
Agar da siz xam, hush bu ish ornilarini bittasini igalamaqchi bulsaniz, IT House-nin kiber khasidik yonlalashi da o'qish ingiz gireg.
